title: Coordinates of θξ for a rectifiable triple are locally Hⁿ⌞M-integrable
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, M ⊆ ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (NVector (Eucl P) n) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ. Then for every compact K ⊆ U and every n-covector c ∈ Λⁿ(ℝ^P), the function x ↦ θ(x)·ξ(x)(c) is integrable on K with respect to ν := Hⁿ⌞M (Lean: (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ c : Covector (Eucl P) n, IntegrableOn (fun x => θ x * ξ x c) K ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M)
